prerequisites: It is highly recommended that students have acquired the competencies corresponding to the subjects of previous semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Social attitude of ethical and deontological commitment
Ability to interpret technical documentation.
Ability to consider environmental factors in decision-making.
Ability for critical reasoning.
Competence in the critical contextualization of knowledge, establishing interrelationships with social, economic and environmental problems, local and/or global.
Competence in the application of ethical principles related to sustainability values in personal and professional behaviors.
Competence in participating in community processes that promote sustainability.
Competence in the sustainable use of resources and in the prevention of negative impacts on the natural and social environment.
Ability to work in a multidisciplinary team
Basic knowledge and application of environmental technologies and sustainability
Applied knowledge of business organization
Knowledge and abilities to organize and manage projects. Know the organizational structure and functions of a project office.

Ability for the drafting, signing and development of projects in the field of industrial engineering that have as their object, the construction, renovation, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing and automation processes
Ability to direct the activities that are the object of the engineering projects described in competence CG01.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks
Ability to handle specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan in the field of business and other institutions and organizations
Knowledge, understanding and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the field
Ability to solve problems.
Ability to make decisions
Ability to organize and plan.
Ability to work in a team.
Attitude of motivation for quality and continuous improvement
Ability to analyze and synthesize.
Ability to adapt to new situations
Ability to communicate with non-experts in the field.
Aptitude for oral and written communication in the native language.
Ability for autonomous and deep learning
Organize and manage projects and apply knowledge of project organization and management in business and environmentally friendly environments, adapting to current legislation and regulations.
Know the general criteria for the formal elaboration of the documents that constitute a technical project.
Know the organizational structure and functions of a project office and a Project Management team.
Learn the basic techniques of project management and direction.

syllabus_topics: 1.1. Definition of the Project in Engineering
Theme 2. The Engineering Project and Organizations
Theme 4. Phases of the Technical Project
Theme 5. Structure of the Technical Project
6.1. The Final Career Project in Engineering
6.2. Regulations of the Final Degree Project
teaching_methods: Sessions where the theoretical contents of each topic will be presented, with emphasis on those considered more difficult.
Sessions dedicated to the application of concepts acquired in theoretical sessions, to seminars and exercises.
Sessions dedicated to the application of concepts acquired in theoretical sessions, to seminars and exercises in computer practical sessions.
Students must submit a series of reports on the practices and seminars carried out.
Students may make use of individual and virtual tutorials to solve problems that may arise during the execution of these activities.

assessment_methods.method: Case study: Planning of a technological project (engineering entrepreneurship through technological innovation)
